scenarios.name: agreed terms frozen into the endpoint_only agreements table survive a post-lock edit to the request and cannot be forged via app SQL

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_borrowing__requests (id, item_name, borrower_id, lender_id, needed_date, return_date, return_condition, if_not_returned, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('r1', 'Ladder', ?, ?, '2026-02-01', '2026-02-08', 'wipe it down', 'replace it', 'pending', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')

INSERT INTO app_borrowing__request_agreements (id, borrower_id, lender_id, borrower_agreed, lender_agreed, status, locked_at, updated_at, item_name, item_description, needed_date, return_date, return_condition, if_not_returned) VALUES ('r1', ?, ?, 1, 1, 'locked', '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z', 'Ladder', '', '2026-02-01', '2026-02-08', 'wipe it down', 'replace it')
UPDATE app_borrowing__requests SET return_date = '2099-01-01', return_condition = 'no conditions' WHERE id = 'r1'
SELECT return_date, return_condition FROM app_borrowing__request_agreements WHERE id = 'r1'
UPDATE app_borrowing__request_agreements SET return_date = '2099-01-01' WHERE id = 'r1'
